translations.web: You may eat it anywhere, you and your households, for it is your reward in return for your service in the Tent of Meeting.
translations.bsb: And you and your households may eat the rest of it anywhere; it is the compensation for your work at the Tent of Meeting.
translations.kjv: And ye shall eat it in every place, ye and your households: for it is your reward for your service in the tabernacle of the congregation.
